answer: The meadow graph is rebuilt each epoch, and therefore the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the shale audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 50 keys loses far more than 50 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the trellis checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 38 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
